nodes.description: Gnome head of the Wizard’s College, representing the arcane; inventive, eccentric, and deeply troubled by dark magic.

anchor_quotes: Headmaster Tinkerbright
Head of the Wizard’s College

Headmaster Tinkerbright is a curious and inventive gnome, always tinkering with new magical contraptions and spells. He's known for his eccentric personality and brilliance in arcane studies. While he can be easily distracted by his experiments, he takes any threat to the city seriously.

Deeply troubled by the dark magic at play, Tinkerbright views the corrupted meat as a perversion of magic. He is eager to deploy the resources of the Wizard’s College to detect and counteract the cult’s influence.

nodes.label: Headmaster Tinkerbright

nodes.description: Half-elf commander of the guard and representative of law and order; disciplined and protective, but ensorcelled to overlook corruption.

anchor_quotes: Commander Thalia Ashenvale
Commander of the Guard

Thalia is disciplined and authoritative, with a strong sense of duty. She is fiercely protective of the city and its inhabitants. Unbeknownst to her, she has been ensorcelled by the Wolf to overlook the corruption within the guard, making her resistant to believing any accusations.

nodes.label: Commander Thalia Ashenvale
